channel.title: Tutor — Weekly Wrist Arthroplasty & Biomechanics
channel.description: A weekly 20–30 minute two-host walk through the past week of wrist reconstruction and biomechanics literature — total wrist arthroplasty (implant design, survivorship, revision, outcomes); native-wrist and carpal biomechanics (kinematics/kinetics, ligament/TFCC/DRUJ mechanics, load transfer, cadaveric/finite-element/in-vitro/4D-CT studies); intercarpal ligament injuries (scapholunate, lunotriquetral, midcarpal instability, perilunate) and their reconstruction; and wrist arthritis treatments (SLAC/SNAC, proximal row carpectomy, limited/total fusion, denervation). Key studies, corresponding authors, and clinically relevant takeaways. Generated automatically from PubMed.
